title: Container Bookings: cancellation relief settings and premium refund notice by tier
content:
## Scope
This table covers the Container Bookings product line and gives, per tier, the number of carrier rolls from which a customer may cancel without a cancellation fee, whether cancellation is free when the line rejected the booking's dangerous-goods acceptance, and the minimum notice before ETD for a cancelled booking to have its loading guarantee premium refunded.

## What each setting means
- **Carrier rolls for free cancellation**: the number of carrier rolls on a booking from which the customer may cancel without a cancellation fee.
- **Free cancellation after dangerous-goods rejection**: whether cancellation is free when the line rejected the booking's dangerous-goods acceptance.
- **Premium refund notice**: the minimum number of calendar days before ETD at which a cancelled booking still gets its loading guarantee premium refunded.

## Tier table
| Tier | Carrier rolls for free cancellation | Free cancellation after dangerous-goods rejection | Premium refund notice (calendar days before ETD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Spot Saver | 2 | yes | 0 |
| AHL Spot Flex | 1 | yes | 0 |
| AHL Contract Booking | 1 | yes | 0 |
| AHL Contract Priority | 1 | yes | 0 |
| AHL Guaranteed Loading | 1 | yes | 10 |
| AHL Premium Express | 1 | yes | 7 |

## Points of judgement
**Does any tier need more than one carrier roll before free cancellation opens?** Yes: AHL Spot Saver needs 2 carrier rolls; every other tier needs 1.

**Is the dangerous-goods rejection relief tier-specific?** The setting is yes on all six tiers.

**Which tiers set a premium refund notice above zero?** AHL Guaranteed Loading (10 calendar days) and AHL Premium Express (7 calendar days).
